groups.activity: wait for Operation: Plague Star to go live

live.text: the Blueprint is only sold while the event is running

rows.label: Operation: Plague Star
rows.note: Nights of Naberus sells the same Blueprint from Daughter in years the event doesn't run

conditions: Untradeable — no plat shortcut and no way to buy it once the window closes.
Naberus and Plague Star alternate; if Plague Star already ran this year, don't count on Naberus too.

groups.meta: no daily cap; standing persists between events

rows.label: Advanced bounty
rows.note: Lvl 55-65, 3,200 standing, +75 drone bonus; needs an Eidolon Phylaxis and Infested Catalyst per player

rows.label: Steel Path bounty
rows.note: Lvl 100-110, 3,800 standing, +100 drone bonus; same Phylaxis/Catalyst requirement
rows.alt: the base Plague Star bounty needs neither item

conditions: Rank-ups to Champion cost 6,000 standing total (1,000 + 2,000 + 3,000); the Blueprint itself is a further 2,000 unless the free Rank 3 item is spent on it.
bonuses: Rank 3 Champion's free item pick can be the Plague Keewar Blueprint itself, covering its 2,000-standing cost.
Keeping the escort drone above 80% health during stage 3 is the entire bonus-standing mechanic.

disclosures.title: rank ladder
disclosures.body: Rank 1 Collaborator: 1,000 standing, 10 Grokdrul, 5,000cr. Rank 2 Defender: 2,000 standing, 10 Iradite, 10,000cr. Rank 3 Champion: 3,000 standing, 10 Nistlepod, 20,000cr. Each rank-up grants one free item of that rank.

rows.label: Plague Keewar Blueprint
rows.note: 2,000 standing + 3,500cr, or free as the Rank 3 item pick

conditions: Nakak is the only farmable source. Hok's plat-only Today's Special gilded Zaw can roll Plague parts at random, but that isn't something you can farm toward.

groups.activity: buy a cheap Grip and Link

rows.label: Peye Grip Blueprint
rows.alt: any two-handed grip (Jayap, Seekalla, Kroostra, Shtung) for a Staff instead

conditions: The cheapest Grip and Link are fine if you only want the Mastery; a built Zaw can never be taken apart.

groups.activity: mine and refine the Strike's gem and alloy, gather Grip and Link materials

rows.label: Alloy Plate
rows.note: Peye Grip; common resource, not Plains-specific

rows.label: Khut-Khut Venom Sac
rows.note: Jai Link; fillet Khut-Khut or loot Thumpers

rows.label: Cetus Wisp
rows.alt: buy at Nakak for 750 standing + 1,500cr each

conditions: 1,600 Nano Spores and 700 Plastids for the Strike are common resources most players already have banked.

rows.label: Plague Keewar Strike
rows.note: 5,000cr, 1,600 Nano Spores, 700 Plastids, 10 Esher Devar, 60 Coprite Alloy

rows.label: Peye Grip
rows.note: 5,000cr, 20 Iradite, 50 Fish Oil, 850 Alloy Plate, 60 Pyrotic Alloy

rows.label: Jai Link
rows.note: 5,000cr, 10 Nistlepod, 20 Pyrotic Alloy, 2 Condroc Wing, 5 Khut-Khut Venom Sac

rows.label: gild at rank 30
rows.note: 2 Cetus Wisp + 5,000 Ostron standing; resets to rank 0, level again

conditions: Gilding requires Ostron Trusted rank; an ungilded Zaw gives zero Mastery.
Mastery is tied to the Strike alone, so extra Grip/Link choices don't add more.
bonuses: For builds the community consensus favors Plague Kripath over Keewar; the Keewar staff/scythe is fine but not top tier today.
